honoraires.honoraires_page_fixed_fee_description: A global amount is set for the entire mission entrusted, regardless of the time spent. This method offers better budget predictability.
honoraires.honoraires_page_result_fee_description: It is added to a base fee (fixed or time-based). The lawyer receives a percentage of the gains or savings obtained through their intervention. In France, a result-based fee alone is prohibited: it must be combined with a principal fee.
honoraires.honoraires_page_legal_aid_description: If the client meets certain resource conditions, they may benefit from total or partial coverage of fees by the State. The lawyer then agrees to intervene within the framework of this system.
honoraires.honoraires_page_consultation_description: The first consultation allows us to evaluate your legal situation and define the most appropriate strategy. Its duration and methods are adapted to the complexity of your case.

visa.title: Visas and visa refusals
visa.subtitle: Applying for a visa for France can quickly become a complicated journey. When a refusal is issued, sometimes without any real explanation, it often jeopardises important plans, whether personal, family or professional. Based in Pau, the firm assists people facing a visa refusal and helps them bring the necessary appeals, both before the administration and before the competent courts.

item1.title: Understanding the grounds for a visa refusal
item1.description: A visa may be refused for many reasons: insufficient supporting documents, doubts about the purpose of the stay, resources deemed inadequate or a risk of remaining unlawfully on French territory. Reviewing the file makes it possible to identify the legal basis of the refusal and to develop a suitable strategy.

item2.title: Challenging a visa refusal: what steps to take?
item2.description: A visa refusal is not necessarily final. Avenues of appeal exist, provided that strict deadlines and precise procedural rules are respected. The firm of Maître Kirimov assists you with preliminary administrative appeals and, where appropriate, with challenging the decision before the courts.

visa.footerDescription: A visa refusal should not be accepted without analysis. Rigorous legal support makes it possible to assess the prospects of an appeal and to defend your situation effectively before the administration. Based in Pau, the firm assists clients residing in France or abroad who face visa refusals issued by the French authorities. Maître Kirimov accordingly acts in Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie and, more broadly, throughout France.
visa.metaTitle: Visa refusal in Pau – Immigration law lawyer
visa.metaDescription: Lawyer in Pau to challenge a visa refusal. Legal support in immigration law across Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie.

regroupement-familial.title: Family reunification
regroupement-familial.subtitle: Family reunification allows a foreign national lawfully residing in France to bring their family within a legal framework. This strictly regulated procedure involves precise conditions and sometimes lengthy timeframes. In Pau, Maître Kirimov assists people wishing to initiate or secure a family reunification application.

item1.title: Understanding the conditions for family reunification
item1.description: The family reunification procedure rests on several cumulative criteria. The conditions concern in particular the lawfulness of the applicant's residence, the length of residence in France, financial resources, housing conditions and the composition of the family. Legal support makes it possible to check that the file complies with the requirements before it is submitted.

item2.title: Building and following up the file
item2.description: Building a family reunification file requires the production of numerous administrative documents, which are often difficult to gather when family members reside abroad. Maître Kirimov assists you in preparing the file, checking the supporting documents and following up the procedure with the administration.

item3.title: Refusal of family reunification: what are the options?
item3.description: A refusal of family reunification can have significant consequences on personal and family life. However, applicants do have avenues of appeal to challenge the refusal of a family reunification application; the assistance of a lawyer makes it possible to assess the file's prospects of success and to find a solution suited to each case.

regroupement-familial.footerDescription: Family reunification is an essential process for many families, but it requires rigorous preparation. Maître Kirimov supports you in following up your file and defends you effectively before the competent courts.
regroupement-familial.metaTitle: Family reunification in Pau – Immigration lawyer
regroupement-familial.metaDescription: Lawyer in Pau for family reunification. Legal support in immigration law across Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie.

demandes-dasile-et-recours-cnda.title: Asylum applications and CNDA appeals
demandes-dasile-et-recours-cnda.subtitle: Asylum applications concern people facing situations of danger, persecution or serious threats in their country of origin. This procedure raises major human and legal stakes and requires strict rules to be respected. The firm supports asylum seekers throughout the procedure and in appeals before the National Court of Asylum (CNDA).

item1.title: Understanding the asylum application procedure
item1.description: The asylum procedure rests on strict deadlines and precise formalities. A misunderstood step or an error in the file can be enough to jeopardise obtaining refugee status or subsidiary protection. Legal support makes it possible to secure each phase of the process and to move forward with greater peace of mind.

item2.title: Preparing the file and the OFPRA interview
item2.description: The interview with the French Office for the Protection of Refugees and Stateless Persons (OFPRA) is a key stage in an asylum application. The firm supports you beforehand, both in preparing your account and in gathering supporting evidence and preparing for the interview, so as to present a clear, consistent and legally sound file.

item3.title: Appeals before the CNDA
item3.description: If the asylum application is rejected by OFPRA, it is possible to bring the matter before the National Court of Asylum within particularly short deadlines. This stage calls for careful analysis of the decision handed down, as well as rigorous preparation of the appeal. Legal support makes it possible to build a strong line of argument, to gather the relevant evidence and to assist the applicant throughout the procedure, in particular at the hearing before the CNDA.

demandes-dasile-et-recours-cnda.footerDescription: Applying for asylum is a demanding procedure that requires rigorous preparation. Suitable legal support makes it possible to defend your right to protection in France effectively. Based in Pau, Maître Kirimov assists asylum seekers in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques, but also more broadly across Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie. Each situation is handled with attentiveness, confidentiality and rigour, respecting each person's own journey and circumstances.

titres-de-sejour-et-oqtf.title: Residence permits and OQTF
titres-de-sejour-et-oqtf.subtitle: Matters relating to residence permits, like decisions imposing an obligation to leave French territory (OQTF), are among the most delicate situations in immigration law. They often arise within very short timeframes and can have immediate repercussions on personal, family or professional life.

item1.title: Applying for and renewing residence permits
item1.description: Applying for or renewing a residence permit rests on precise conditions, which vary according to each person's personal, family or professional situation. An upfront analysis is often necessary to identify the most suitable permit and to avoid mistakes that could delay or jeopardise the procedure. Legal support thus makes it possible to put together a complete and coherent file, and to secure dealings with the prefecture at every stage of the process.

item2.title: Refusal of a residence permit: understanding and acting
item2.description: A refusal of a residence permit can have immediate and particularly serious consequences on the personal, family or professional situation of the person concerned. In this context, the involvement of a lawyer makes it possible to analyse the decision carefully, to check that procedural safeguards have been respected and to identify the available avenues of appeal. This support is essential in order to act effectively within the applicable deadlines and to defend the rights of the person concerned as fully as possible.

item3.title: Challenging an OQTF within tight deadlines
item3.description: An obligation to leave French territory (OQTF) comes with particularly short appeal deadlines. Any inaction or procedural error can quickly render the decision final. The firm supports you in analysing the lawfulness of the OQTF, preparing a suitable appeal and defending your rights before the administrative court, at every stage of the procedure.

titres-de-sejour-et-oqtf.footerTitle: Human support, attentive to your needs

procedures-disciplinaires.title: Disciplinary proceedings in the public service
procedures-disciplinaires.subtitle: Disciplinary proceedings can have significant consequences on the career and professional path of a public-sector employee. Depending on the situation, the administration may consider various measures, ranging from a warning to heavier sanctions, and even to exclusion or dismissal of the official.

item1.title: Understanding disciplinary proceedings
item1.description: Disciplinary proceedings are governed by strict rules specifically intended to safeguard the rights of the public-sector employee. Failure to respect these safeguards can have a direct bearing on the lawfulness of the sanction contemplated or imposed by the administration. Legal support makes it possible to understand clearly the allegations made, to identify the applicable procedural safeguards and to approach the proceedings with a better grasp of what is at stake.

item2.title: Challenging a disciplinary sanction
item2.description: A disciplinary sanction may be challenged where it appears disproportionate, insufficiently founded or imposed following irregular proceedings. In this context, the support of a lawyer makes it possible to analyse the decision taken by the administration and to identify the relevant grounds of challenge. The firm assists the employee both in administrative appeals and before the administrative court, in order to defend their rights effectively.

harcelement-moral.title: Workplace harassment in the public service
harcelement-moral.subtitle: Workplace harassment in the public service is a serious attack on the dignity, health and working conditions of public-sector employees. It often develops gradually and sometimes insidiously, making it difficult to identify and to have it recognised. Its consequences can be particularly heavy, both professionally and personally. In Pau, Maître Kirimov assists public-sector employees facing situations of workplace harassment, to help them have the facts recognised and to defend their rights.

item1.title: Recognising a situation of workplace harassment
item1.description: Workplace harassment is characterised by repeated conduct leading to a deterioration in working conditions. It may take the form of excessive pressure, exclusion, belittling remarks or harm to health. Legal support makes it possible to characterise the facts in legal terms and to confront such conduct.

item2.title: Rights and protections of the public-sector employee
item2.description: Public-sector employees benefit from specific protections when facing situations of workplace harassment. The administration is required to safeguard the health, safety and dignity of its employees in the exercise of their duties. This obligation involves not only preventing situations of harassment, but also responding to them appropriately when they are brought to its attention.

item3.title: Building a file and initiating proceedings
item3.description: Building a strong file is a decisive step in having a situation of workplace harassment recognised. It involves gathering all available evidence and presenting the facts in a clear, consistent and chronological manner, so as to allow a precise analysis of the situation. It is essential to collect even the smallest piece of evidence that could advance the case. Anticipation and preparation are therefore the watchwords of a strong file.

harcelement-moral.footerTitle: Human support, attentive to your needs
harcelement-moral.footerDescription: Workplace harassment should never be trivialised. Suitable legal support makes it possible to have the situation recognised, to protect the employee and to obtain compensation commensurate with the harm suffered. Based in Pau, the firm assists public-sector employees in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques, as well as in Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie, with confidentiality and determination.

maladie-professionnelle.title: Occupational illness and work-related accidents in the public service
maladie-professionnelle.subtitle: Both occupational illness and work-related accidents can have significant consequences on the health, career and rights of public-sector employees. Having them recognised by the administration can, however, prove complex and give rise to difficulties, challenges and even refusals, requiring particular attention at every stage of the procedure.

item1.title: Understanding the concept of attributability to service
item1.description: Recognition of an occupational illness or a work-related accident rests on the concept of attributability to service. It is then necessary to establish a direct link between the professional activity and the harm caused to the employee's health. This recognition is of particular importance, since it determines, among other things, the coverage of care, the maintenance of remuneration and entitlement to specific leave.

item2.title: Steps for the recognition of an occupational illness
item2.description: Recognition of an occupational illness in the public service follows a regulated administrative procedure that requires the production of precise medical and professional evidence. This evidence makes it possible to assess the link between the employee's state of health and their working conditions, and determines the outcome of the application.

item3.title: Work-related accident: asserting your rights
item3.description: An accident occurring in the course of service may give rise to specific recognition, with significant consequences for the employee concerned. This recognition is not, however, automatic and may be the subject of discussion or challenge by the administration. Legal support then makes it possible to characterise the accident precisely, to establish its link with the service and to defend the employee's rights throughout the procedure.

item4.title: Challenging a refusal of recognition
item4.description: A refusal to recognise an occupational illness or a work-related accident can have significant consequences on the employee's situation. It may, in particular, affect medical coverage, remuneration or leave entitlements, and lastingly weaken the professional situation of the person concerned.

creation-et-structuration.title: Creation and structuring of businesses
creation-et-structuration.subtitle: Setting up a business is the first step towards turning a project into reality, allowing it to be organised and ultimately brought to life. Choosing the corporate form (SAS, SARL, SASU, EI and so on), drafting the articles of association, completing administrative formalities and dealing with taxation: the project holder must carefully study the design of their company so that it meets their expectations and serves their interests. The firm supports you throughout your project, both in advisory work and in litigation.

item1.title: Choosing the legal form suited to your project
item1.description: The rules governing a company are determined by its corporate form. Choosing a form suited to your project and your ambitions is therefore crucial for the business to thrive. The most appropriate form will vary depending on the number of partners and on the projects and activities the company envisages. For example, the SAS offers shareholders greater freedom but requires carefully drafted articles of association, whereas the SARL benefits from a complete statutory framework. The chosen form will also affect the director's social security regime. This aspect must therefore be taken into account when the company is set up.

item2.title: Drafting the articles of association and legal organisation
item2.description: A genuine cornerstone, the articles of association are intended to govern the entire operation of the company: from the allocation of share capital and the appointment and removal of the director to the holding of general meetings, they make it possible to tailor how the company runs (within the limits imposed by law). It is also possible to insert a whole range of clauses to optimise the company's governance (approval clause, non-competition clause and so on).

item3.title: Securing the launch of the business
item3.description: Launching a business is often a particular period: it is the moment when the first essential contracts are signed (lease, supply, franchise and so on). It is also a period of uncertainty for the company, which will face its first difficulties. It is not uncommon for the company still to be in the process of formation at launch, which triggers the application of a specific legal regime.

creation-et-structuration.footerDescription: Based in Pau, the firm assists entrepreneurs in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques as well as those in Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie, with concrete knowledge of local economic realities. Creating and structuring a business should never be treated as a mere formality. contrats-commerciaux.title: Drafting and securing commercial contracts
contrats-commerciaux.subtitle: Commercial contracts are of vital importance to a company and represent its source of revenue. Poorly drafted contracts can lead to lengthy deadlocks and disputes between contracting parties. Maître Asmae Kirimov supports clients through the various phases in the life of a contract, from its formation through its performance and ultimately its termination.

item1.title: Why secure your commercial contracts legally?
item1.description: The legal security of contracts is a key factor for a company. Without it, sustaining a lasting business over the long term is difficult to envisage. Sale, supply, procurement and partnership agreements each have their own legal regime and subtleties that must be mastered to ensure that the relationship runs smoothly.

item2.title: Drafting contracts tailored to your business
item2.description: Adaptability and agility must guide the hand of anyone drafting a contract. Many contract templates exist online, but none can truly be adapted to the constraints of your company. Maître Kirimov has solid experience in contract law and is able to draft your future contractual provisions while respecting your constraints and your needs.

item3.title: Reviewing and securing existing contracts
item3.description: Identifying risks is a crucial concern wherever a contract is involved. A thorough review brings legal weaknesses to light and helps identify any provisions that are no longer up to date. It will be essential to update the company's contract templates so that they always reflect the latest legal developments.

item4.title: Anticipating disputes and protecting the business
item4.description: A well-drafted contract is one that anticipates potential disputes, locks them down and provides a means of resolving them as quickly as possible while avoiding litigation. Naturally, anticipation increases a company's legal protection against non-performance or services that fall short of contractual expectations. The contract may, for example, set out what each party expects from the relationship by means of a preamble. It may also provide for arbitration or mediation clauses in order to avoid court proceedings.

contrats-commerciaux.footerDescription: Based in Pau, the firm assists micro-businesses, SMEs, entrepreneurs and traders in Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Occitanie, with personalised and responsive follow-up. Being well supported from the contract formation stage allows the director to manage the company's activity without worrying about the reliability of its contracts. The firm offers tailored support to meet all your needs.

relations-commerciales-internationales.title: International commercial relations
relations-commerciales-internationales.subtitle: For a company, opening up to international markets brings new challenges and great opportunities. However, these also come with their share of legal issues: applicable law, competent jurisdiction and so on. International law is full of subtleties and calls for support from a qualified professional.

item1.title: Securing your international transactions legally
item1.description: International trade naturally involves dealing with partners subject to a different legislative and regulatory framework. It is therefore essential to structure international transactions through clear agreements that will serve as the law between the parties.

item2.title: Drafting and reviewing international commercial contracts
item2.description: An international commercial contract requires particular care. The contracting parties must agree not only on the terms of the service but also on the competent jurisdiction and the law applicable in the event of a dispute. A fine knowledge of the rules of international law, combined with meticulous drafting, can turn a restrictive body of legislation into a new opportunity.

item3.title: Anticipating disputes and protecting the company's interests
item3.description: Complex by nature, international contracts call for a strong capacity to anticipate and must not be drafted without prior thought. Arbitration and choice-of-forum clauses are particularly liable to be challenged when a conflict arises. A reliable and secure contract makes it possible to foresee the outcome of a dispute and provides comfort and legal certainty.

relations-commerciales-internationales.footerTitle: Support from Pau towards international markets
relations-commerciales-internationales.footerDescription: Located in Pau, the firm offers support towards international markets. The firm is dedicated to helping companies in Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Occitanie and, more generally, throughout France. International commercial relations are an important driver of growth, provided they are legally well managed. Suitable support makes it possible to secure transactions and to support sustainable international development.

privacy.confidentiality_definitions_content:
The Publisher: The person, physical or legal, who publishes the online public communication services.

The Site: All websites, web pages, and online services offered by the Publisher.

The User: The person using the Site and services.

privacy.confidentiality_section_1_content:
In the context of using the Sites, the Publisher may collect the following categories of data concerning its Users:

Civil status, identity, identification data...
privacy.confidentiality_section_2_title: 2- Communication of personal data to third parties
privacy.confidentiality_section_2_content:
No communication to third parties

Your data is not communicated to any third parties. However, you are informed that they may be disclosed in application of a law, regulation, or by virtue of a decision of a competent regulatory or judicial authority.
privacy.confidentiality_section_3_title: 3- Prior information for the communication of personal data to third parties in case of merger/absorption
privacy.confidentiality_section_3_content:
Prior information and opt-out possibility before and after the merger/acquisition

In the event that we participate in a merger, acquisition, or any other form of asset transfer, we undertake to guarantee the confidentiality of your personal data and to inform you before they are transferred or subject to new confidentiality rules.
privacy.confidentiality_section_4_part1:
Aggregation with non-personal data

We may publish, disclose, and use aggregated information (information relating to all our Users or to specific groups or categories of Users that we combine in such a way that an individual User can no longer be identified or mentioned) and non-personal information for sector and market analysis, demographic profiling, promotional and advertising purposes, and other commercial purposes.
privacy.confidentiality_section_4_part2:
Aggregation with personal data available on the User's social accounts

If you link your account to another service's account to make cross-posts, said service may provide us with your profile, login, and any other information you have authorized to disclose. We may aggregate information relating to all our other Users, groups, accounts, with personal data available about the User.
privacy.confidentiality_section_6_content:
Use of the user ID only for access to services

We use your electronic identifiers only for and during the execution of the contract.
privacy.confidentiality_section_7_content:
Use of the user ID only for access to services

We use your electronic identifiers only for and during the execution of the contract.
privacy.confidentiality_section_8_duration:
Cookie retention period

In accordance with CNIL recommendations, the maximum retention period for cookies is 13 months maximum after their first deposit on the User's terminal, as well as the duration of the User's consent to the use of these cookies. The cookie lifespan is not extended with each visit. The User's consent must therefore be renewed after this period.
privacy.confidentiality_section_8_purpose:
Purpose of cookies

Cookies may be used for statistical purposes, in particular to optimize the services provided to the User, based on the processing of information concerning access frequency, page personalization, as well as operations carried out and information consulted. You are informed that the Publisher may place cookies on your terminal. The cookie records information relating to navigation on the service (pages you have consulted, date and time of consultation...) that we may read during your subsequent visits.
privacy.confidentiality_section_8_optin:
Opt-in for cookie deposit

We do not use cookies. If we were to use them in the future, you would be informed beforehand and have the option to disable these cookies.
privacy.confidentiality_section_9_content:
Retention period of technical data

Technical data is retained for the strictly necessary period to achieve the purposes mentioned above.
privacy.confidentiality_section_10_title: 10 - Retention period of personal data and anonymization
privacy.confidentiality_section_10_contract:
Retention of data during the contractual relationship

In accordance with Article 6-5° of Law No. 78-17 of January 6, 1978, relating to data processing, files, and freedoms, personal data subject to processing is not retained beyond the time necessary for the performance of the obligations defined at the conclusion of the contract or the predefined duration of the contractual relationship.
privacy.confidentiality_section_10_anonymization:
Retention of anonymized data beyond the contractual relationship / after account deletion

We retain personal data for the strictly necessary period to achieve the purposes described in these Privacy Policies. Beyond this period, they will be anonymized and retained for exclusively statistical purposes and will not give rise to any exploitation of any kind.
privacy.confidentiality_section_10_delete:
Data deletion after account deletion

Data purge measures are implemented to ensure effective deletion as soon as the retention or archiving period necessary for the fulfillment of the determined or imposed purposes is reached. In accordance with Law No. 78-17 of January 6, 1978, relating to data processing, files, and freedoms, you also have a right to delete your data, which you can exercise at any time by contacting the Publisher.
privacy.confidentiality_section_10_inactivity:
Data deletion after 3 years of inactivity

For security reasons, if you have not logged into the Site for a period of three years, you will receive an email inviting you to log in as soon as possible, otherwise your data will be deleted from our databases.
privacy.confidentiality_section_11_user_delete:
Account deletion upon request

The User can delete their Account at any time, by simple request to the Publisher OR via the Account deletion menu in the Account settings if applicable.
privacy.confidentiality_section_11_violation_del:
Account deletion in case of violation of the Privacy Policy

In case of violation of one or more provisions of the Privacy Policy or any other document incorporated herein by reference, the Publisher reserves the right to terminate or restrict without any prior warning and at its sole discretion, your use and access to the services, your account, and all Sites.
privacy.confidentiality_section_12_title: 12 - Indications in case of security breach detected by the Publisher
privacy.confidentiality_section_12_user_notice:
User information in case of security breach

We undertake to implement all appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security adapted to the risks of accidental, unauthorized, or illegal access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or destruction of your personal data. In the event that we become aware of illegal access to your personal data stored on our servers or those of our providers, or unauthorized access resulting in the realization of the risks identified above, we undertake to: Notify you of the incident as soon as possible; Examine the causes of the incident and inform you; Take necessary measures within reasonable limits to mitigate the negative effects and damages that may result from said incident.
privacy.confidentiality_section_12_liability:
Limitation of liability

Under no circumstances can the commitments defined above regarding notification in case of a security breach be assimilated to any acknowledgment of fault or liability regarding the occurrence of the incident in question.
privacy.confidentiality_section_13_content:
No transfer outside the European Union

The Publisher undertakes not to transfer the personal data of its Users outside the European Union.

https://www.cnil.fr/fr/la-protection-des-donnees-dans-le-monde
privacy.confidentiality_section_14_content:
In case of modification of this Privacy Policy, commitment not to lower the level of confidentiality substantially without prior information of the persons concerned

We undertake to inform you in case of substantial modification of this Privacy Policy and not to lower the level of confidentiality of your data substantially without informing you and obtaining your consent.
privacy.confidentiality_section_15_content:
Arbitration clause

In case of dispute relating to the implementation or interpretation of this Privacy Policy, the parties agree to seek an amicable solution before initiating any legal proceedings.

Applicable law

This agreement is governed by French law.
privacy.confidentiality_section_16_content:
Data portability

The Publisher undertakes to offer you the possibility of having all your data returned to you upon simple request. The User is thus guaranteed better control over their data and retains the possibility of reusing them. This data must be provided in an open and easily reusable format.
